input.quote: However, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties.
input.rationale: Subparagraph 18.1 is an evergreen continuation: after the 25-year Initial Period the Agreement continues in operation and our only unilateral exit is on not less than one (1) year's prior notice. Computed in days that is a ~365-day non-renewal notice window, far beyond the fallback ceiling of 60 days and inside walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. The other paragraphs of Paragraph 18 (18.2-18.7 - unanimous in-term termination, decommissioning votes, exit accounting) do not provide any shorter exit route. There is no renewal price-uplift mechanic: charges remain actual Capital Costs and O&M Costs shared in the Schedule B proportions, and 11.3 confirms no additional charges, so the conditional price element is satisfied as drafted. We therefore target the fallback and make the single shortest change - a 60-day window for Teleglobe USA - while leaving the one-year period in place for the other Parties, since shortening their notice would strip us of warning before we must absorb a withdrawing Party's obligations under 18.5.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: 11.3 For each Terminal Station Right of Use, the Parties hereto shall not be required to pay any additional charges over and above the Capital Costs and O&M costs.

proposal.summary: Shorten Teleglobe USA's exit notice under Subparagraph 18.1 from one year to 60 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement continues automatically after the 25-year Initial Period and our only exit requires a full year's prior notice, which exceeds our 60-day ceiling for a non-renewal notice window. We have shortened the window to sixty days for Teleglobe USA only, leaving the one-year period intact for the other Parties so we retain advance warning of their withdrawals.

ops.oldText: However, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties.
ops.newText: However, any Party may terminate its participation in this Agreement at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice thereof (not less than sixty (60) days' prior notice in the case of Teleglobe USA Inc.), in writing, to the other Parties.
